note: Maps each gold-rule field to a registry fact. 'use_existing' reuses a fact already in src/rules/fact_registry.json; 'new' describes a fact the staging tool will propose (always pending review). Hindi and Marathi wording is a draft and needs native-speaker review. Fields missing here are blocked until added or drafted with --draft-missing.

is_nri.reviewer_check: Registry fact is limited to new PM-KISAN beneficiaries.

family_has_constitutional_post_holder.reviewer_check: Confirm the registry wording covers the same office holders.

family_has_government_employee.reviewer_check: Confirm wording and the Class IV / Group D carve-out.

is_name_in_land_records.reviewer_check: Registry fact is about the family's land in State/UT records; confirm it matches this clause.

is_below_poverty_line.meaning: Does the applicant's household live below the poverty line (BPL) according to the criteria of the Government of India?
is_below_poverty_line.reviewer_check: The registry already has name_on_bpl_list and bpl_card_shown. Decide whether to reuse one of them for this scheme instead.

en.text: Does your family live below the poverty line (BPL)?
en.help_text: If you are not sure, answer 'don't know'.

hi.text: क्या आपका परिवार गरीबी रेखा से नीचे (बीपीएल) है?
hi.help_text: अगर आपको पक्का नहीं पता, तो 'पता नहीं' चुनें।

mr.help_text: तुम्हाला खात्री नसेल, तर 'माहीत नाही' निवडा.

is_citizen_of_india.meaning: Is the applicant a citizen of India?

en.text: Are you a citizen of India?

hi.text: क्या आप भारत के नागरिक हैं?

is_resident_of_state.meaning: Is the applicant a resident of Maharashtra?
is_resident_of_state.reviewer_check: State-specific. If schemes of other states are added, this needs a state variable instead.

hi.text: क्या आप महाराष्ट्र में रहते हैं?

has_disability.meaning: Does the applicant have a physical or mental disability?

en.text: Do you have a physical or mental disability?

hi.text: क्या आपको कोई शारीरिक या मानसिक दिव्यांगता है?

mr.text: तुम्हाला शारीरिक किंवा मानसिक दिव्यांगत्व आहे का?

disability_percent.meaning: Disability percentage as shown on the applicant's disability certificate.

en.text: What disability percentage is shown on your disability certificate?

hi.text: आपके दिव्यांगता प्रमाणपत्र में दिव्यांगता कितने प्रतिशत लिखी है?

mr.text: तुमच्या दिव्यांगत्व प्रमाणपत्रावर दिव्यांगत्व किती टक्के नमूद आहे?

is_receiving_other_pension.meaning: Is the applicant already receiving a pension under any social security scheme?

en.text: Are you already receiving a pension under any other social security scheme?

hi.text: क्या आपको किसी अन्य सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजना के तहत पहले से पेंशन मिल रही है?

mr.text: तुम्हाला इतर कोणत्याही सामाजिक सुरक्षा योजनेअंतर्गत आधीच पेन्शन मिळते का?

has_savings_bank_account.meaning: Does the applicant have a savings bank account?

en.text: Do you have a savings bank account?

hi.text: क्या आपका बचत बैंक खाता है?

mr.text: तुमचे बचत बँक खाते आहे का?

is_income_tax_payer.meaning: Is, or has the applicant ever been, an income tax payer?
is_income_tax_payer.reviewer_check: The registry has income_tax_paid_last_assessment_year (PM-KISAN); this scheme asks about being a payer at any time.

en.text: Are you, or have you ever been, an income tax payer?

hi.text: क्या आप आयकर दाता हैं, या कभी रहे हैं?

mr.text: तुम्ही आयकर भरता का, किंवा कधी भरत होता का?

consents_to_auto_debit.meaning: Does the applicant agree to the contribution being deducted automatically from their savings account?

en.text: Do you agree to the contribution being deducted automatically (auto-debit) from your savings account?

hi.text: क्या आप अपने बचत खाते से अंशदान अपने-आप कटने (ऑटो-डेबिट) के लिए सहमत हैं?

mr.text: तुमच्या बचत खात्यातून योगदान आपोआप वजा (ऑटो-डेबिट) होण्यास तुम्ही सहमत आहात का?
